The awg-windows directory is a source copy of github.com/amnezia-vpn/amneziawg-windows/v3 v3.1.20260814. Original copyright and license headers are retained. Local changes isolate service and registry names and make BlockUntunneledTraffic an explicit, default-off option. Configuration writes use plaintext .conf files, with verified migration and read fallback for legacy DPAPI files. The ringlogger package and tunnel log capture have been removed. The protocol engine runs with a silent logger and is otherwise retained. See ../COPYING and the original project links in the main README.
